newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian central bank sells 1.43 trln rbls of bonds.
newsitem.headline: Russian central bank sells 1.43 trln rbls of bonds.

text.p: The central bank sold 1.43 trillion roubles nominal of OFZ interest-bearing government bonds on behalf of the Finance Ministry on Wednesday, raising 1.48 trillion roubles in cash, the bank's open-market operations department said.
The bank made the following transactions:
The bonds were sold at Tuesday's average prices.

The central bank has recently started holding trading sessions on Wednesdays after weekly auctions, trying to soak up the money after the Finance Ministry repays tax-exempt bonds early on a voluntary basis. The central bank does not usually hold trading on Wednesdays when auctions take place.

Apart from intervening on its own account for liquidity-smoothing and monetary policy purposes, the central bank buys and sells securities as part of its management of the Finance Ministry's debt and asset portfolio.
